ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: On Love and Pain. This workshop builds upon a student’s foundational studio practice to make work in response to texts about the dichotomous notions of love and pain. Texts used in this course will include All About Love by bell hooks, The Art of Cruelty by Maggie Nelson, and Regarding the Pain of Others by Susan Sontag. We will have a series of readings, screenings, discussions, and projects that respond to the challenges of representing love and pain through photography, video, and installation art.
